Question: Using NHANES from 2009 to 2016 we will run  logistic regression using the exam survey weights where predictor is UACR-SACR ratio,  calculated as urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio UACR (mg/g)/ (serum albumin ALB (g/dL)/serum creatinine SCR (mg/dL))) and then categorized in quartiles(%) Q1: <=25, Q2: >25 and <=50, Q3: >50 and <=75, Q4: >75. Outcome is diabetic retinopathy. Covariates include age (years), sex, race categorized as non-hispanic white, non-hispanic black, mexican american, other hispanic, and other race, education level adults 20  categorized as primary school, secondary, school, college or above, or not recorded, poverty income ratio (PIR), categorized as Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, and Q_unknown (for missing values). Excluded participants  had missing values or said “No” or “Borderline”  to the question doctor told you have diabetes. Participants who were not told by doctors whether they had diabetic retinopathy were excluded. Participants with missing serum albumin ALB (g/dL) or serum creatinine SCR (mg/dL) or urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio UACR (mg/g) will be excluded. Participants who were less than 20 years old were excluded.
Structured Question:
Analysis Type: weighted logistic regression (exam)

Dataset: NHANES

Period of Interest: 2009-2016

Inclusion Criteria:
- doctor told you have diabetes is not "No"
- doctor told you have diabetes is not "Borderline"
- doctor told you have diabetes is not missing
- told by doctors whether they had diabetic retinopathy is not missing
- age (years) >= 20

Exclusion Criteria:
- missing serum albumin ALB (g/dL)
- missing serum creatinine SCR (mg/dL)
- missing urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio UACR (mg/g)

Covariates:
- age (years)
- sex
- race categorized as:
  non-hispanic white,
  non-hispanic black,
  mexican american,
  other hispanic,
  other race
- education level adults 20 categorized as:
  primary school,
  secondary school,
  college or above,
  not recorded
- poverty income ratio (PIR) categorized as:
  Q1,
  Q2,
  Q3,
  Q4,
  Q_unknown (for missing values)

Predictor:
- UACR-SACR ratio calculated as:
  urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio UACR (mg/g) / (serum albumin ALB (g/dL) / serum creatinine SCR (mg/dL))
  categorized into quartiles:
    Q1: <=25%
    Q2: >25% and <=50%
    Q3: >50% and <=75%
    Q4: >75%

Outcome:
- diabetic retinopathy = 1 if "yes"; 0 if "no"

FROM nhanes.demo_f
WHERE full_sample_2_year_mec_exam_weight IS NOT NULL

FROM temp_psu_stratum s

  ON s.respondent_sequence_number = w.respondent_sequence_number;

    t0."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes",
    t1."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy",
    t2."age_in_years_at_screening",
    t3."albumin_g_dl",
    t4."creatinine_mg_dl",
    t5."albumin_creatinine_ratio_mg_g",
    t6."gender",
    t7."race_hispanic_origin",
    t8."education_level_adults_20",
    t9."ratio_of_family_income_to_poverty"
FROM temp_all_ids a
LEFT JOIN temp_master_doctor_told_you_have_diabetes t0 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t0.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy t1 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t1.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_age_in_years_at_screening t2 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t2.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_albumin_g_dl t3 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t3.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_creatinine_mg_dl t4 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t4.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_albumin_creatinine_ratio_mg_g t5 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t5.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_gender t6 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t6.respondent_sequence_number 
LEFT JOIN temp_master_race_hispanic_origin t7 ON a.respondent_sequence_number = t7.respondent_sequence_number

    SELECT respondent_sequence_number FROM weight_design
);


-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Includes patients who were told by a doctor they have diabetes (not 'No' and not 'Borderline' and not NULL)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" IS NOT NULL
  AND "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" != 'No'
  AND "doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" != 'Borderline';

-- STEP 1.2: From the above group, include only those who were told by doctors whether they had diabetic retinopathy (not NULL)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 1.3: From the above group, include only those who are 20 years old or older
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."age_in_years_at_screening" >= 20;

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Exclude patients with missing serum albumin ALB (g/dL)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step3 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."albumin_g_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude patients with missing serum creatinine SCR (mg/dL)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."creatinine_mg_dl" IS NOT NULL;

-- STEP 2.3: Exclude patients with missing urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio UACR (mg/g)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN final_master_table f ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."albumin_creatinine_ratio_mg_g" IS NOT NULL;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3;

-- ========== STEP 4: Variables ==========

-- 4.1 Age (years)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_age_years AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."age_in_years_at_screening" AS "age_years"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.2 Sex
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_sex AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."gender" AS "sex"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.3 Race
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_race AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic White' THEN 'non-hispanic white'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Non-Hispanic Black' THEN 'non-hispanic black'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Mexican American' THEN 'mexican american'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Other Hispanic' THEN 'other hispanic'
           WHEN f."race_hispanic_origin" = 'Other Race - Including Multi-Racial' THEN 'other race'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "race"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.4 Education Level Adults 20
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_education_level_adults_20 AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."education_level_adults_20" IN ('Less Than 9th Grade', 'Less than 9th grade') THEN 'primary school'
           WHEN f."education_level_adults_20" IN ('9-11th Grade (Includes 12th grade with no diploma)', '9-11th grade (Includes 12th grade with no diploma)', 'High School Grad/GED or Equivalent', 'High school graduate/GED or equivalent') THEN 'secondary school'
           WHEN f."education_level_adults_20" IN ('Some College or AA degree', 'Some college or AA degree', 'College Graduate or above', 'College graduate or above') THEN 'college or above'

       END AS "education_level_adults_20"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- 4.5 Poverty Income Ratio (PIR)
-- Calculate raw poverty income ratio for cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_poverty_income_ratio_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       f."ratio_of_family_income_to_poverty" AS "poverty_income_ratio"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";

-- Compute quartile cutoffs for poverty income ratio within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_poverty_income_ratio_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "poverty_income_ratio") AS q1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "poverty_income_ratio") AS q2,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "poverty_income_ratio") AS q3
FROM temp_poverty_income_ratio_raw
WHERE "poverty_income_ratio" IS NOT NULL;

-- Assign poverty income ratio quartile group
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_poverty_income_ratio_pir AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN "poverty_income_ratio" IS NULL THEN 'Q_unknown'
    WHEN "poverty_income_ratio" <= (SELECT q1 FROM temp_poverty_income_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q1'
    WHEN "poverty_income_ratio" <= (SELECT q2 FROM temp_poverty_income_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q2'
    WHEN "poverty_income_ratio" <= (SELECT q3 FROM temp_poverty_income_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q3'
    ELSE 'Q4'
  END AS "poverty_income_ratio_pir"
FROM temp_poverty_income_ratio_raw;

-- 4.6 UACR-SACR Ratio (Predictor)
-- Calculate raw uacr-sacr ratio for cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_raw AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       (f."albumin_creatinine_ratio_mg_g" / (f."albumin_g_dl" / f."creatinine_mg_dl")) AS "uacr_sacr_ratio"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE (f."albumin_g_dl" / f."creatinine_mg_dl") != 0; -- Avoid division by zero

-- Compute quartile cutoffs for uacr-sacr ratio within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uacr_sacr_ratio") AS q1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5)  WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uacr_sacr_ratio") AS q2,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "uacr_sacr_ratio") AS q3
FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_raw
WHERE "uacr_sacr_ratio" IS NOT NULL;

-- Assign uacr-sacr ratio quartile group
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_uacr_sacr_ratio AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN "uacr_sacr_ratio" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN "uacr_sacr_ratio" <= (SELECT q1 FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q1: <=25%'
    WHEN "uacr_sacr_ratio" <= (SELECT q2 FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q2: >25% and <=50%'
    WHEN "uacr_sacr_ratio" <= (SELECT q3 FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_cutoffs) THEN 'Q3: >50% and <=75%'
    ELSE 'Q4: >75%'
  END AS "uacr_sacr_ratio"
FROM temp_uacr_sacr_ratio_raw;

-- 4.7 Diabetic Retinopathy (Outcome)
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetic_retinopathy AS
SELECT c."respondent_sequence_number",
       CASE
           WHEN f."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy" = 'Yes' THEN 1
           WHEN f."diabetes_affected_eyes_had_retinopathy" = 'No' THEN 0
           ELSE NULL
       END AS "diabetic_retinopathy"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number";
